notes_list.title: ⚖️ Supreme Court of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 28 January 1950
📜 Article: 124
❤️ Article 32: Samvidhan ka Hridaya
👨‍⚖️ First CJI: Harilal Kania
👩‍⚖️ First Woman Justice: Fathima M. Beevi
👨‍⚖️ Current CJI: B. R. Gavai
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Supreme Court = Samvidhan ki highest judicial authority. Article 124 → Supreme Court ki establishment/constitution se joda hua. Article 32 ko Dr. B. R. Ambedkar ne Samvidhan ka 'Heart and Soul' kaha tha.

notes_list.title: 📈 SEBI – Securities and Exchange Board of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 12 April 1988
📜 Statutory Status: SEBI Act 1992 (30 Jan 1992)
📍 Headquarters: Mumbai
👤 Current Chairman: Tuhin Kanta Pandey
🎯 Agenda: Share bazaron mein niveshakon ke hiton ki raksha
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: SEBI = Share market ki SECURITY. SEBI ko yaad rakho → Securities + Exchange + Board + India. Main focus = investors ke interests ki protection.

notes_list.title: 🛡️ DRDO – Defence Research and Development Organisation
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1958
📍 Headquarters: Delhi
👤 CEO: Sameer V. Kamat
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: DRDO = Defence Research & Development Organisation → Defence ke liye Research + Development. 1958 ko DRDO se directly link karke yaad rakho.

notes_list.title: 🚆 Bharatiya Railway Board
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: March 1905
📍 Headquarters: New Delhi
👤 CEO: Satish Kumar
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Railway Board → Railway ka central board. March 1905 = Railway Board ko yaad rakhne ki key date.

notes_list.title: 🏅 IOC – Indian Olympic Association
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1927
📍 Headquarters: New Delhi
👥 Founders: Sir Dorabji Tata, A. G. Noehren
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Indian Olympic Association = India + Olympics. 1927 ko sports organizations ke context mein yaad rakho. Founders: Dorabji Tata + A. G. Noehren.

notes_list.title: 🛡️ CISF – Central Industrial Security Force
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 10 March 1969
📍 Headquarters: New Delhi
👤 DG: Rajwinder Singh Bhatti
🎯 Motto: Sanrakshan evam Suraksha
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: CISF = Industrial installations ki Security Force. 'Sanrakshan evam Suraksha' → CISF ka direct motto.

notes_list.title: 🏦 RBI – Reserve Bank of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1 April 1935
📜 Commission: Hilton Young Commission
🇮🇳 Nationalization: 1 January 1949
📍 Headquarters: Mumbai
👤 First Governor: Osborne Smith
🇮🇳 First Indian Governor: C. D. Deshmukh
👤 Current Governor: Sanjay Malhotra
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: RBI = India ka central banking institution. 1935 = establishment, 1949 = nationalization. Hilton Young Commission ko RBI se connect karo. First Indian Governor = C. D. Deshmukh.

notes_list.title: 🏭 CII – Confederation of Indian Industry
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1895
📍 Headquarters: New Delhi
👤 CEO: Sanjiv Puri
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: CII = Indian Industry ka representative organization. CII ko 'Industry' word se directly connect karke yaad rakho.

notes_list.title: 🏛️ NITI Aayog – National Institution for Transforming India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1 January 2015
📍 Headquarters: New Delhi
👑 Chairman: PM
👤 Vice-Chairman: Suman Bery
👤 CEO: B. V. R. Subrahmanyam
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: NITI = National Institution for Transforming India. 2015 mein Planning Commission ke replacement ke roop mein NITI Aayog ko yaad karo. Chairman = Prime Minister.

notes_list.title: 🚨 NDRF – National Disaster Response Force
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 19 January 2006
🎯 Motto: Aapda Seva Sadaiv Sarvatra
👤 DG: Piyush Anand
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: NDRF = Disaster Response Force. 'Aapda Seva Sadaiv Sarvatra' → disaster ke time seva, hamesha aur har jagah.

notes_list.title: 🪪 UIDAI – Unique Identification Authority of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 28 January 2009
📍 Headquarters: Delhi
👤 CEO: Bhubnesh Kumar
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: UIDAI = Unique Identification Authority → Aadhaar se direct connection. 28 January 2009 ko UIDAI se link karo.

notes_list.title: 📡 TRAI – Telecom Regulatory Authority of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 20 February 1997
👤 CEO: Anil Kumar Lahoti
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: TRAI = Telecom Regulatory Authority of India → Telecom sector ka regulator. TRAI ko 'Telephone/Telecom Regulation' se yaad rakho.

notes_list.title: 🏦 Punjab National Bank – PNB
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 19 May 1894
👤 Chairman: Ashok Chandra
🎯 Motto: The name you can bank upon
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: PNB = Punjab National Bank. 1894 → important old Indian bank. Motto mein 'bank upon' directly PNB se connect hota hai.

notes_list.title: 🔬 CSIR – Council of Scientific and Industrial Research
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 26 September 1942
👤 CEO: Nallathamby Kalaiselvi
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: CSIR = Scientific + Industrial Research. Science aur industry dono words ko CSIR ke naam se directly connect karo.

notes_list.title: 🛡️ NSG – National Security Guard

📅 Established: 22 September 1986
👤 DG: B. Srinivasan
🎯 Motto: Sarvatra Sarvottam Suraksha
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: NSG = National Security Guard. Motto mein 'Sarvottam Suraksha' → Security Guard ko direct yaad karata hai.

notes_list.title: 🏔️ ITBP – Indo-Tibetan Border Police
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1962
👤 DG: Rahul Rasgotra
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: ITBP = Indo-Tibetan Border Police → India-Tibet border. 1962 ko China/Tibet border security context se yaad rakho.

notes_list.title: 🛡️ CRPF – Central Reserve Police Force
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 27 July 1939
👤 DG: Anish Dayal Singh
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: CRPF = Central Reserve Police Force. 'Central + Reserve + Police' ko naam ke through directly remember karo.

notes_list.title: 🌾 NABARD – National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1982
📍 Headquarters: Mumbai
👤 CEO: K. V. Shaji
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: NABARD naam mein hi Agriculture + Rural Development ka clue hai. NABARD = rural/agricultural development finance.

notes_list.title: 💻 NASSCOM – National Association of Software and Service Companies
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1998
👤 CEO: Rajesh Nambiar
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: NASSCOM = Software + Services Companies. Computer/IT industry se NASSCOM ko direct connect karo.

notes_list.title: 🏛️ UPSC – Union Public Service Commission

📅 Established: 1 October 1926
📜 Article: 315
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: UPSC = Union Public Service Commission. Article 315 → Public Service Commissions. 1 October 1926 ko UPSC se link karo.

notes_list.title: 🏢 FICCI – Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1927
👤 CEO: Subhrakant Panda
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: FICCI = Indian Commerce + Industry chambers ka federation. Commerce aur Industry dono ko naam se connect karo.

notes_list.title: 🏏 BCCI – Board of Control for Cricket in India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1928
📍 Headquarters: Mumbai
👤 CEO: Roger Binny
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: BCCI = Cricket in India ka Board. BCCI ko India + Cricket se direct connect karo. 1928 = establishment.

notes_list.title: 🚀 ISRO – Indian Space Research Organisation
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1969
👤 CEO: S. Somanath
🎯 Ideology: Manav jati ki seva mein antariksh praudyogiki
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: ISRO = Indian Space Research Organisation → Space + Research. 1969 ko ISRO ke establishment year ke roop mein yaad rakho.

notes_list.title: 🛡️ IRDAI – Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India

👤 CEO: Debasish Panda
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: IRDAI = Insurance Regulatory + Development Authority. Insurance sector ka regulator yaad karo.

📅 Established: 9 July 1988

notes_list.title: 📞 BSNL – Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 2000
👤 CEO: P. K. Purwar
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: BSNL = Bharat Sanchar → communication/telecom. 'Sanchar' word ko telecom se direct connect karo.

notes_list.title: ⚙️ NALCO – National Aluminium Company
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1981
👤 CEO: Sridhar Patra
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: NALCO ke naam mein Aluminium ka direct clue hai. NALCO = National Aluminium Company.

notes_list.title: 📊 ICAI – Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1949
👤 CEO: Ranjeet Kumar Agarwal
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: ICAI = Chartered Accountants ka professional institute. 'CA' ko ICAI ke beech mein identify karo.

notes_list.title: 🏦 HDFC – Housing Development Finance Corporation

📅 Established: 1994
📍 Headquarters: Mumbai
👤 CEO: Sashi Jagdishan
🎯 Motto: We understand your world

notes_list.title: 🔎 CVC – Central Vigilance Commission
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 11 February 1964

notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: CVC = Central Vigilance Commission → Vigilance = monitoring/checking. 'V' ko Vigilance se direct connect karo.

notes_list.title: 🌾 FCI – Food Corporation of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 11 January 1965
👤 CEO: Ashutosh Agnihotri
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: FCI = Food Corporation of India. F = Food → naam se hi direct answer.

notes_list.title: 📈 NSE – National Stock Exchange of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1992
📍 Headquarters: Mumbai
👤 CEO: Ashishkumar Chauhan
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: NSE = National Stock Exchange → Stock market se direct connection. Mumbai = major financial centre.

notes_list.title: 📑 CAG – Comptroller and Auditor General of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1858
👤 CEO: K. Sanjay Murthy
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: CAG = Comptroller + Auditor General → Government accounts ka audit. 'Auditor' word ko CAG se direct connect karo.

notes_list.title: 🏭 SIDBI – Small Industries Development Bank of India

📍 Headquarters: Lucknow, U.P.
👤 CEO: Manoj Mittal
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: SIDBI = Small Industries Development Bank → Small Industries/MSME finance se direct connection. Headquarters = Lucknow.

notes_list.title: 📏 BIS – Bureau of Indian Standards

📅 Established: 23 December 1986
🏛️ Founders: Bharatiya Sansad
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: BIS = Indian Standards. Quality/standardization ko BIS se direct connect karo. ISI mark bhi standards context mein important hai.

notes_list.title: 🍱 FSSAI – Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 5 September 2008
👤 CEO: G. Kamala Vardhana Rao
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: FSSAI = Food Safety + Standards. Food safety aur food standards ko FSSAI se directly connect karo.

notes_list.title: 🏦 IFCI – Industrial Finance Corporation of India
notes_list.basic_overview: 📅 Established: 1 July 1948
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: IFCI = Industrial Finance Corporation of India. 'Industrial Finance' ko IFCI acronym se direct yaad karo.

notes_list.title: 📊 CDSL – Central Depository Services Limited

📍 Headquarters: Mumbai
👤 CEO: Nehal Vora
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: CDSL = Central Depository Services → shares/securities ke dematerialized records/depository system se connection.

📍 Headquarters: 1 September 1956
👤 CEO: Siddhartha Mohanty
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: LIC = Life Insurance Corporation → Life Insurance ko LIC se direct connect karo. Source data mein headquarters field bhi 1 September 1956 diya gaya hai.

👤 CEO: Vikas Kaushal
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: HPCL = Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited → Petroleum sector ka PSU. Mumbai headquarters ko HPCL se connect karo.

notes_list.title: 🛢️ ONGC – Oil and Natural Gas Corporation
notes_list.basic_overview:

👤 CEO: Arun Kumar Singh
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: ONGC = Oil + Natural Gas Corporation. Naam mein hi Oil aur Gas dono ka clue hai.

notes_list.title: 🏦 SBI – State Bank of India

📍 Headquarters: Mumbai

notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: SBI = State Bank of India. 1 July 1955 ko SBI se directly connect karo. Headquarters = Mumbai.

📍 Headquarters: Mumbai

notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: BARC = Bhabha + Atomic Research Centre. Atomic/Nuclear research ko BARC se direct connect karo.

notes_list.title: 🔍 CBI – Central Bureau of Investigation

notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: CBI = Central Bureau of Investigation → Investigation ko CBI se direct connect karo.

notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: ASSOCHAM = Associated Chambers + Commerce + Industry. Commerce aur Industry chambers ko ASSOCHAM se yaad rakho.

notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1963
👤 CEO: Ravi Agrawal
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: CBDT = Central Board of Direct Taxes → Direct Tax = Income Tax type taxes. CBDT ko direct taxation se connect karo.

notes_list.title: 📈 BSE – Bombay Stock Exchange
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 1875
👤 CEO: Sundararaman Ramamurthy
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: BSE = Bombay Stock Exchange. 1875 ko Indian stock market history ke context mein yaad rakho.

notes_list.title: 🔍 NIA – National Investigation Agency

📅 Established: 31 December 2008
👤 CEO: Sadanand Vasant Date
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: NIA = National Investigation Agency → National-level investigation. NIA ko investigation/security se direct connect karo.

notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: BSF = Border Security Force → Border = BSF. 1 December 1965 ko BSF establishment ke saath yaad karo. Motto = Duty Unto Death.

notes_list.title: 💰 CBIC – Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs

👤 CEO: Sanjay Kumar Agarwal
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: CBIC = Central Board of Indirect Taxes + Customs. Indirect tax + Customs ko CBIC se direct connect karo.

notes_list.title: 🗳️ Election Commission of India
notes_list.basic_overview:
📅 Established: 25 January 1950
👤 First CEC: Sukumar Sen
👤 Current CEC: Gyanesh Kumar
notes_list.extra_info_content: 🧠 Trick: Election Commission = Elections conduct karne wali constitutional authority. 25 January 1950 → National Voters' Day bhi isi date se linked hai. First CEC = Sukumar Sen.
